scope: Only the paired-floor source adapter: canonical anchor addressing, direct Gamma/OU simulation, complete source diagnostics, common-random-number coupling and CV0 numerical control identity.

validation.fixture_scope: Separate validation namespace only. Identical-address deterministic re-evaluations are validation, not resampling or new scientific replications.

independent_checks: Constructed scientific cell descriptors and SHA256 identities from canonical JSON independently; cross-checked the canonical Cell convention, 12 actual IDs and 4 epsilon=1e-6 anchor IDs.
Constructed SeedSequence(21261009,spawn_key=(4,*eight_32bit_anchor_words,rep)).spawn(2) directly, without using the production sampler or new anchor helper for reference addressing.
Generated raw Gamma gaps from the exact fixed shape/scale pairs (4/9,9/8), (1/4,2), (1/9,9/2); CV0 uses regular half-unit gaps.
Applied max(raw_gap,epsilon*nominal_mean_gap) only for nominal CV>=1.5, constructed cumulative float64 timestamps, and verified exact array/hash equality without mean/span rescaling.
Drew stationary X0 using the path-child normal draw before the K standard normal innovations; independently recursed exact OU transitions using differences of final float64 timestamps.
Every times/state array and little-endian float64 SHA256 matched exactly for all 24 validation realizations.

Every inherited/new source diagnostic was compared: exact identities/counts/booleans/spawn-key strings/hashes, and tight-tolerance independent longdouble mean/population-CV and Gamma-distribution moment references.

Within each CV/rep group, raw Gamma arrays, stationary X0, standard normal innovations and spawn keys are shared across all 3 variants; standardized innovations recovered from actual states agree up to transition-rounding error.

When two fixed validation variants have identical floored gap vectors, their times and states coincide exactly; when their floored vectors differ in these fixtures, their physical times and states differ.

CV0 negative control uses one shared sample per replication: every complete registered-engine inference field, Hessian/covariance/SE/interval value, validity/status and embedded diagnostic JSON agrees exactly across all 3 epsilon values.

The adapter preserves each actual scientific ID/floor separately from the seed anchor, delegates all physical parameters unchanged, and emits no diagnostic cell_id that could overwrite the result-row ID.
mathematical_interpretation: These are paired common-random-number OU realizations, not independent observations across epsilon and not one continuous OU trajectory observed on three grids.
A floor change may leave a finite high-CV realization unchanged if it affects no raw gap. Null/equal outcomes are legitimate and are never forced to differ.
Different CVs have distinct canonical anchor addresses; validation checks the prescribed addressing, not an empirical independence theorem.
The source adapter changes no estimator, inference gate, observation normalization, interval construction or existing source implementation.
The source adapter does not implement the future paired contrasts, durable floor execution, full audit or full sensitivity experiment.

mathematical_note_extension.explanation: The parent-authorized floor-only mathematical section was appended before any frozen selected-source scientific run. The historical path review retains its original note hash; this review binds the extended note.

limits: Only fixed validation seed21261009, reps0/1 were used. No full exploratory seed20261009 data or selected headline paths were generated or replayed.
This source-module approval is not a claim that the full Week7 floor experiment, paired comparisons or artifact audit is implemented or completed.
